segs.p: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantaamanāpo hoti purisassa.
segs.e: “Mendicants, when a lady has five factors she is extremely undesirable to a man.

segs.p: Na ca rūpavā hoti, na ca bhogavā hoti, na ca sīlavā hoti, alaso ca hoti, pajañcassa na labhati—
segs.e: She’s not attractive, wealthy, or ethical; she’s idle, and she doesn’t beget children.

segs.p: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantaamanāpo hoti purisassa.
segs.e: When a lady has these five factors she is extremely undesirable to a man.

segs.p: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantamanāpo hoti purisassa.
segs.e: When a lady has five factors she is extremely desirable to a man.

segs.p: Rūpavā ca hoti, bhogavā ca hoti, sīlavā ca hoti, dakkho ca hoti analaso, pajañcassa labhati—
segs.e: She’s attractive, wealthy, and ethical; she’s deft and tireless, and she begets children.

segs.p: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekantamanāpo hoti purisassā”ti.
segs.e: When a lady has these five factors she is extremely desirable to a man.”

segs.p: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantaamanāpo hoti mātugāmassa.
segs.e: “Mendicants, when a man has five factors he is extremely undesirable to a lady.

segs.p: Na ca rūpavā hoti, na ca bhogavā hoti, na ca sīlavā hoti, alaso ca hoti, pajañcassa na labhati—
segs.e: He’s not attractive, wealthy, or ethical; he’s idle, and he doesn’t beget children.

segs.p: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantaamanāpo hoti mātugāmassa.
segs.e: When a man has these five factors he is extremely undesirable to a lady.

segs.p: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantamanāpo hoti mātugāmassa.
segs.e: When a man has five factors he is extremely desirable to a lady.

segs.p: Rūpavā ca hoti, bhogavā ca hoti, sīlavā ca hoti, dakkho ca hoti analaso, pajañcassa labhati—
segs.e: He’s attractive, wealthy, and ethical; he’s deft and tireless, and he begets children.

segs.p: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato puriso ekantamanāpo hoti mātugāmassā”ti.
segs.e: When a man has these five factors he is extremely desirable to a lady.”

segs.p: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa āveṇikāni dukkhāni, yāni mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
segs.e: “Mendicants, there are these five kinds of suffering that particularly apply to ladies. They’re undergone by ladies and not by men.

segs.p: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo daharova samāno patikulaṁ gacchati, ñātakehi vinā hoti.
segs.e: Firstly, a lady, while still young, goes to live with her husband’s family and is separated from her relatives.

segs.p: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa paṭhamaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
segs.e: This is the first kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

segs.p: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmo utunī hoti.
segs.e: Furthermore, a lady undergoes the menstrual cycle.

segs.p: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dutiyaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
segs.e: This is the second kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

segs.p: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmo gabbhinī hoti.
Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa tatiyaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
segs.e: This is the third kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

segs.p: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa catutthaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
segs.e: This is the fourth kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

segs.p: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmo purisassa pāricariyaṁ upeti.
segs.e: Furthermore, a lady provides services for a man.

segs.p: Idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa pañcamaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
segs.e: This is the fifth kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

segs.p: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa āveṇikāni dukkhāni, yāni mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehī”ti.
segs.e: These are the five kinds of suffering that particularly apply to ladies. They’re undergone by ladies and not by men.”

segs.p: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: “Mendicants, when ladies have three qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are mostly reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

segs.p: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pubbaṇhasamayaṁ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati.
segs.e: A lady lives at home with heart full of the stain of stinginess in the morning, jealousy in the afternoon, and sexual desire in the evening.

segs.p: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
segs.e: When ladies possess these three qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are mostly reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.”

segs.p: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā anuruddho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then Venerable Anuruddha went up to the Buddha, sat down to one side, and said to him:

segs.p: “idhāhaṁ, bhante, mātugāmaṁ passāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjantaṁ.
segs.e: “Sometimes, sir, with my clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, I see that a female—when her body breaks up, after death—is reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

segs.p: Katīhi nu kho, bhante, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti?
segs.e: How many qualities do ladies have so that they’re reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell?”

segs.p: “Pañcahi kho, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: “Anuruddha, when ladies have five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

segs.p: Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, kodhano ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, irritable, and witless.

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
segs.e: When ladies possess these five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.”

segs.p: “Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, upanāhī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, acrimonious, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, issukī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, jealous, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, maccharī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, stingy, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe…
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, aticārī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, adulterous, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, dussīlo ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, unethical, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, appassuto ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, unlearned, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, kusīto ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, lazy, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, muṭṭhassati ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, unmindful, and witless. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe… nirayaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: “Anuruddha, when ladies have five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

segs.p: Pāṇātipātī ca hoti, adinnādāyī ca hoti, kāmesumicchācārī ca hoti, musāvādī ca hoti, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhāyī ca hoti—
segs.e: They kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, and consume intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor.

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
segs.e: When ladies possess these five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.”

segs.p: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā anuruddho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
segs.e: Then Venerable Anuruddha went up to the Buddha … and asked him,

segs.p: “idhāhaṁ, bhante, mātugāmaṁ passāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantaṁ.
segs.e: “Sometimes, sir, with my clairvoyance that is purified and superhuman, I see that a female—when her body breaks up, after death—is reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

segs.p: Katīhi nu kho, bhante, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatī”ti?
segs.e: How many qualities do ladies have so that they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm?”

segs.p: “Pañcahi kho, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: “Anuruddha, when ladies have five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

segs.p: Saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottappī ca hoti, akkodhano ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti—
segs.e: They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, loving, and wise.

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
segs.e: When ladies possess these five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

segs.p: “Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
Saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottappī ca hoti, anupanāhī ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti—
segs.e: “… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, free of acrimony, and wise. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
Saddho ca hoti, hirimā ca hoti, ottappī ca hoti, anissukī ca hoti, paññavā ca hoti …pe….
segs.e: “… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, free of jealousy, and wise. …”
“… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, free of stinginess, and wise. …”
“… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, not adulterous, and wise. …”
“… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, ethical, and wise. …”
“… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, learned, and wise. …”
“… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, energetic, and wise. …”
“… They’re faithful, conscientious, prudent, mindful, and wise. …”

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
“Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: “Anuruddha, when ladies have five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

segs.p: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato ca hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato ca hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato ca hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato ca hoti, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato ca hoti—
segs.e: They don’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor.

segs.p: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjatī”ti.
segs.e: When ladies possess these five qualities, when their body breaks up, after death, they are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”
“Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

segs.p: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni.
segs.e: These are the five powers of a lady.

segs.p: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṁ ajjhāvasatī”ti.
segs.e: A lady living at home with these five qualities is self-assured.”
“Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

segs.p: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni.
segs.e: These are the five powers of a lady.

segs.p: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo sāmikaṁ pasayha agāraṁ ajjhāvasatī”ti.
segs.e: A lady living at home with these five powers has her husband under her thumb.”
“Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

segs.p: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni.
segs.e: These are the five powers of a lady.

segs.p: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo sāmikaṁ abhibhuyya vattatī”ti.
segs.e: A lady with these five powers lives having mastered her husband.”

segs.p: “Ekena ca kho, bhikkhave, balena samannāgato puriso mātugāmaṁ abhibhuyya vattati.
segs.e: “Mendicants, by means of one power a man lives having mastered a lady.
By means of what one power?

segs.p: Issariyabalena abhibhūtaṁ mātugāmaṁ neva rūpabalaṁ tāyati, na bhogabalaṁ tāyati, na ñātibalaṁ tāyati, na puttabalaṁ tāyati, na sīlabalaṁ tāyatī”ti.
segs.e: When a lady has been mastered by the power of authority, her powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior do not avail her.”
“Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca bhogabalena—
segs.e: A lady who has the power of attractiveness but not the power of wealth

segs.p: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca—
segs.e: But when she has the power of attractiveness and the power of wealth

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, na ca ñātibalena—
segs.e: A lady who has the powers of attractiveness and wealth, but not the power of relatives

segs.p: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca—
segs.e: But when she has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, and relatives

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, na ca puttabalena—
segs.e: A lady who has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, and relatives, but not the power of children

segs.p: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca—
segs.e: But when she has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, and children

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca, na ca sīlabalena—
segs.e: A lady who has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, and children, but not the power of ethical behavior

segs.p: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca, sīlabalena ca—
segs.e: But when she has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior

segs.p: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balānī”ti.
segs.e: These are the five powers of a lady.”
“Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca sīlabalena, nāsenteva naṁ, kule na vāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the power of attractiveness but not that of ethical behavior, the family will send her away, they won’t accommodate her.

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, na ca sīlabalena, nāsenteva naṁ, kule na vāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the powers of attractiveness and wealth but not that of ethical behavior, the family will send her away, they won’t accommodate her.

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, na ca sīlabalena, nāsenteva naṁ, kule na vāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, and relatives, but not that of ethical behavior, the family will send her away, they won’t accommodate her.

segs.p: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca, na ca sīlabalena, nāsenteva naṁ, kule na vāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, and children, but not that of ethical behavior, the family will send her away, they won’t accommodate her.

segs.p: Sīlabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca rūpabalena, vāsenteva naṁ, kule na nāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the power of ethical behavior but not that of attractiveness, the family will accommodate her, they won’t send her away.

segs.p: Sīlabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca bhogabalena, vāsenteva naṁ, kule na nāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the power of ethical behavior but not that of wealth, the family will accommodate her, they won’t send her away.

segs.p: Sīlabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca ñātibalena, vāsenteva naṁ, kule na nāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the power of ethical behavior but not that of relatives, the family will accommodate her, they won’t send her away.

segs.p: Sīlabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca puttabalena, vāsenteva naṁ, kule na nāsenti.
segs.e: If a lady has the power of ethical behavior but not that of children, the family will accommodate her, they won’t send her away.

segs.p: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balānī”ti.
segs.e: These are the five powers of a lady.”
“Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

segs.p: Na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: It is not because of the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, or children that ladies, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

segs.p: Sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
segs.e: It is because of the power of ethical behavior that ladies, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

segs.p: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balānī”ti.
segs.e: These are the five powers of a lady.”
“Mendicants, there are five things that are hard to get for ladies who have not made merit.
‘May I be born into a suitable family!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gaccheyyanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born in a suitable family, may I marry into a suitable family!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā, patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā, asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvaseyyanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born in a suitable family and married into a suitable family, may I live at home without a co-wife!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā, patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā, asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born in a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, may I have children!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, catutthaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā, patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā, asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṁ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born in a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, and having had children, may I live having mastered my husband!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca ṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmenāti.
segs.e: These are the five things that are hard to get for ladies who have not made merit.

segs.p: Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmena.
segs.e: There are five things that are easy to get for ladies who have made merit.
‘May I be born into a suitable family!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gaccheyyanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born into a suitable family, may I marry into a suitable family!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvaseyyanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born into a suitable family and married into a suitable family, may I live at home without a co-wife!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born into a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, may I have children!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, catutthaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṁ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti—
segs.e: ‘Having been born into a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, and having had children, may I live having mastered my husband!’

segs.p: idaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmenā”ti.
segs.e: These are the five things that are easy to get for ladies who have made merit.”

segs.p: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṁ ajjhāvasati.
segs.e: “Mendicants, a lady living at home with five qualities is self-assured.

segs.p: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato ca hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato ca hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato ca hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato ca hoti, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato ca hoti—
segs.e: She doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor.

segs.p: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṁ ajjhāvasatī”ti.
segs.e: A lady living at home with these five qualities is self-assured.”

segs.p: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati sārādāyinī ca hoti varādāyinī ca kāyassa.
segs.e: “Mendicants, a female noble disciple who grows in five ways grows nobly, taking on what is essential and excellent in this life.

segs.p: Saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, sutena vaḍḍhati, cāgena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati—
segs.e: She grows in faith, ethics, learning, generosity, and wisdom.

segs.p: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati, sārādāyinī ca hoti, varādāyinī ca kāyassāti.
segs.e: A female noble disciple who grows in these five ways grows nobly, taking on what is essential and excellent in this life.
When she grows in faith and ethics,
wisdom, and both generosity and learning—
a virtuous laywoman such as she
takes on what is essential for herself in this life.”
The Linked Discourses on ladies are complete.
